recipes.name: Crème de la Crème à la Edgar inspired by The Aristocats
ingredients: For The Crème de la Crème à la Edgar
instructions: In a food processor add all purpose flour along with baking powder, kosher salt, and granulated sugar. Pulse to combine. - 10 ounces All Purpose Flour - 3 tsp Baking Powder - ½ tsp Kosher Salt - 1 tbsp Granulated Sugar

Next add sliced cold butter along with vegetable oil and mix to combine before drizzling ice cold water into the food processor while it’s processing. When a ball of dough forms, remove and immediately wrap in plastic wrap and place in the fridge for 10-15 minutes. - 6 tbsp Cold Butter - 2 tbsp Vegetable Oil - ⅔ cup Ice Water

Remove dough from the fridge and liberally flour your work surface. Roll out your dough as thin as possible. Using a fluted biscuit cutter, cut out cracker shapes and place them on a parchment lined baking sheet. Using a toothpick add the signature Ritz Cracker 7 holes and then brush all of them down with some melted butter. Place in a 400°F oven for 10-15 minutes.
Once they are golden brown in the oven, remove and brush with butter and immediately sprinkle with some salt.
For The Crème de la Crème à la Edgar
In a pot add heavy cream and whole milk. Stir to combine. - 1 pint Heavy Cream - 1 pint Whole Milk

Scrape one vanilla bean and then add filling as well as the pod to the milk mixture along with sugar, ground cinnamon, ground nutmeg and a pinch of salt. - 1 Vanilla Bean - ⅓ cup Sugar - ¼ tsp Ground Cinnamon - ¼ tsp Ground Nutmeg - pinch of Salt
Just bring to a boil and stir to combine.
